method: Verify candidate response scope and sufficient grayscale monotonicity.
scope: For this candidate, enabling/disabling inherited ambient response leaves geometry and lighting basis unchanged. Geometry DOES change versus previous revision5; the scope is an operator-ablation check, not a prior/current map equality claim. Uniform achromatic inputs only; arbitrary changing colored/spatial backgrounds are unvalidated.
grayscale_proof: For uniform grayscale g: gamma*g^(gamma-1)*gain + sum(response_i*nonnegative_radial_basis_i) >= 0; clipping, positive filtering and convex reflection preserve order.
